# Thomson Reuters
> Thomson Reuters provides technology, research, and workflow solutions for legal, tax, accounting, corporate, government, and trade professionals.

Thomson Reuters combines authoritative content, software, and AI-powered tools to help professionals research, draft, manage risk, comply with regulations, and run complex workflows across legal, tax, audit, accounting, and corporate environments.

## Corporate Site
- [Home](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en): Main entry point for Thomson Reuters products, industries, and company information.
- [Solutions](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions): Overview of solution areas across legal, tax, trade, risk, and compliance.
- [Products](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/products): Directory of Thomson Reuters products and platforms by professional use case.
- [Success Stories](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/success-stories): Customer stories showing product adoption and business outcomes across industries.
- [Insights](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/insights): Articles, analysis, and thought leadership for professionals and business leaders.
- [About Thomson Reuters](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/about-us): Company overview, mission, leadership, and corporate information.
- [Careers](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/careers): Careers, culture, and job opportunities across Thomson Reuters businesses.

## Legal Solutions
- [Legal solutions](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en): Hub for legal products, research, drafting, and practice management solutions.
- [Legal AI](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-ai): AI-powered legal tools including generative AI assistants and workflow automation.
- [Legal research and guidance](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-research-guidance): Research platforms and expert guidance for case law, statutes, and practical know-how.
- [Legal forms](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-forms): Form libraries and drafting tools for legal document creation.
- [Drafting software, service, and guidance](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/drafting-software-service-guidance): Drafting tools and editorial guidance for faster, more accurate legal documents.
- [Evidence](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/evidence): Evidence management and litigation support tools for case preparation.
- [Data and document management](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/data-document-management): Document and knowledge management solutions for legal teams and firms.
- [Business development](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/business-development): Business development and competitive intelligence tools for law firms.

## Law Firms
- [Law firms](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/law-firms): Overview of Thomson Reuters solutions tailored to law firm workflows.
- [Small law firms](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/law-firms/small-law-firms): Tools for smaller firms covering research, drafting, billing, and practice management.
- [Mid-size law firms](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/law-firms/mid-size-law-firms): Solutions for growing firms balancing efficiency, profitability, and client service.
- [Large law firms](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/law-firms/large-law-firms): Enterprise legal technology for complex, multi-office law firm operations.
- [Practical Law](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/practical-law): Know-how, standard documents, and practice notes for transactional and advisory work.
- [Westlaw Precision](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/westlaw-precision): Legal research platform with editorial enhancements and advanced search capabilities.
- [HighQ](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/highq): Collaboration, workflow, and client engagement platform for legal teams.
- [3E](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/3e): Practice and financial management platform for law firms.

## Tax, Audit & Accounting
- [Tax and accounting solutions](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en): Hub for tax, audit, accounting, and firm management products.
- [Audit and accounting](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/audit-accounting): Solutions for audit workflows, accounting firms, and assurance engagements.
- [Tax planning and preparation](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-planning-preparation): Tax workflow tools for planning, compliance, and return preparation.
- [Firm management](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/firm-management): Practice management software for accounting firms and tax professionals.
- [Checkpoint](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/checkpoint): Research platform for tax, accounting, and audit guidance and analysis.
- [ONESOURCE Indirect Tax](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/onesource/indirect-tax): Indirect tax determination, compliance, and reporting solutions.
- [UltraTax CS](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/ultratax-cs): Professional tax preparation software for accounting firms and tax practices.
- [Accounting CS](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/accounting-cs): Write-up, payroll, and client accounting software for firms.

## Corporations
- [Corporations](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/corporations): Overview of solutions for corporate legal, tax, trade, and compliance teams.
- [Corporate tax](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/corporations/corporate-tax): Tax technology and content for enterprise tax planning and compliance.
- [Risk and fraud](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/corporations/risk-fraud): Solutions for fraud prevention, third-party risk, and compliance operations.
- [Trade and supply chain](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/corporations/trade-supply): Tools for customs, trade compliance, and global supply chain visibility.
- [In-house legal](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/corporate-business-organization): Legal operations and business organization solutions for corporate counsel.
- [ONESOURCE](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/onesource): Enterprise tax platform for direct, indirect, and global tax workflows.
- [CLEAR](https://clear.thomsonreuters.com/): Risk, identity, and investigative intelligence platform for due diligence and compliance.

## Governments
- [Governments](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/solutions/governments): Solutions for public sector legal, investigative, and compliance needs.
- [Government legal](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/government): Legal research and workflow tools for government legal professionals.
- [CLEAR for government](https://clear.thomsonreuters.com/en-us/government.html): Investigative and identity intelligence tools for government agencies.
- [Special services](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/special-services): Risk, intelligence, and mission support services for government customers.
- [Reuters for government](https://www.reutersagency.com/en/reuters-for-government/): News and media services tailored for public sector communications needs.

## Product Platforms
- [CoCounsel](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/cocounsel): Generative AI assistant for legal and professional workflows.
- [Westlaw](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/westlaw): Flagship legal research platform for case law, statutes, and secondary sources.
- [Practical Law](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/practical-law): Practical guidance, templates, and standard documents for legal practitioners.
- [HighQ](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/highq): Secure collaboration and workflow automation platform.
- [3E](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/3e): Financial and practice management software for law firms.
- [Checkpoint](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/checkpoint): Tax and accounting research platform with editorial analysis and tools.
- [ONESOURCE](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/onesource): Enterprise suite for global tax determination, compliance, and reporting.
- [CLEAR](https://clear.thomsonreuters.com/): Investigative research and identity verification platform.
